title: Run on a Well-Formed Input
statement: Let $x$ be a binary string whose syntax scan from the formula state ends in the exact-end state. Starting in the scanning state with the formula scanner at position $1$ and empty output, the dual transducer reaches the anchor state at position $1$ with output equal to the polarity-flipping scan of $x$, after exactly $4|x|+4$ steps. At every time strictly before that, it is not in the anchor state.
hypotheses_covered: Scanning $x$ from the formula state ends in the exact-end state
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary string on which the six-state formula syntax scan from formula
level ends in the exact-end state. Started in the formula-level scanning state at head
position $1$ with empty output, the dual transducer reaches the anchor state at
position $1$ with output the polarity-flipping scan of $x$, in exactly $4|x| + 4$ steps
and without visiting the anchor before then.
